entry.title: Cutty Cap Richmond, May 16
entry.content:
From Cutty Cap Richmond






Hark to the old tales of the seven hills of Richmond...this year your Cutty Cap Quest will take you to the very edges of insanity on the hunt for the Richmond Roman Empire.

Charlie Ponticello designed in early-90s Richmond at the City’s behest to mark the major points of the compass, each Column stands 12 feet tall, created from a single, solid mold - and weighing 3500 lbs each!

The hunt is on to find all six remaining columns, and Cutty Caps at the base of each one!

*BEWARE* the path to get to the columns will be treacherous, and each column is parked squarely in the MIDDLE of the center median on MAJOR roadways. Be smart, and look both ways many times before crossing. Pro tip - bring a friend and leave them with your bikes safely roadside - then once the way is clear, trot to the column.

While Seven Roman-inspired Columns once stood, only six remain - and you must find them all!

Bonus adventures along the way will take you to other well loved spots, lil waterfalls, and quiet woods.

entry.title: Cutty Cap Richmond, May 10
entry.content:
From Cutty Cap Richmond



For the SIXTH year of the @ridewithgps Cutty Cap Challenge, we’ve chosen SIX special Richmond legends to find. We’ve been thinking a lot about the Roman Empire…
While seven once stood, hark to the seven hills of this city, now only six remain.
Your quest takes you on an adventure to find them all, with additional bonus features along the way. Ten caps total, waiting for you to catch them. (There might be a bonus cap out there, so maybe eleven)

Download the RWGPS app.
Make sure your email notifications are on.
At 8am on May 16th, check your email for a link to the map!
Get out there and ride!

entry.title: Cutty Cap Richmond, April 25
entry.content:
From Cutty Cap Richmond



MAY 16th, mark your calendars!!!

2026 Cutty Caps have arrived! This year, we handed the canvas to Brazilian illustrator ninhol to bring his vibrant flowing style to life. A fresh look and energy for a growing collection of cutty caps.
As a bonus, we also brought back the classic logo cap this year!
Want to get your hands on one of the limited edition caps?
HOW IT WORKS
On May 16th, caps go out into the wild across 38 cities - Richmond, VA included.
We'll email a link to the map.
You hop on your bike, ride to the caps, and claim yours.
First come, first served.
That's it.
No catch, no fine print. Just you, your bike, and a city full of hidden caps waiting to be found.

Six years in... how many caps do YOU have?
Special shout out to @headdy_original for always delivering on bringing the artwork and caps to the world!
